### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

Several testcases in `generic_config_updater/test_eth_interface.py` are being skipped unconditionally. `test_replace_lane()` is being skipped on suspicion of a suspected test bug back in 2022. `test_update_invalid_index()` and `test_update_valid_index()` are being skipped with a comment about "not being a production scenario", but the git history for that change is not very informative of what that means. Both testcases pass, and they seem to be perfectly valid tests to me. We might as well enable them; if there is a real reason why they should not be run then they should be removed instead.

### Current Behavior

Test skips the given testcases.

### Proposed Behavior

Test runs the given testcases and they pass.

resolution.title: Enable generic_config_updater/test_eth_interface.py
